scope: Actual image follow-up after the generic 32-class direct-contour gate passed. Both 120-photo object panels were previously studied. Fixed nine observers, four repeats each. No selection by target image or panel outcome.
source: Use the archived cohort-9 ordinary uniform JPEG for each recipient and verify against its settings. Original image seed is 923761 plus stimulus row, all four arms edit that same JPEG. Word, fold, donors and eight supports come from the identical fixed-word packet. Train the nine direct ridge maps on all 128 generic classes and retain the 96-object out-of-fold scalar.
editing: Neutral is a single matched quality-95 4:4:4 JPEG re-encoding. Each other arm resamples the uniform source JPEG once and uses the same encoding. Work in the baseline foreground ellipse coordinates with the original mask center and x/y standard deviations fixed. For direction phi, s=0.35*(target_normalized_log_radius(phi)-baseline_normalized_log_radius(phi)). Increase log-odds of normalized radius along that ray by s. The inverse is r_source = r_output / (exp(s)*(1-r_output/R)+r_output/R), where R is the distance to the rectangular image border along the ray. This monotone mapping fixes the center and border and tapers movement near the edge. Bilinear RGB sampling uses the unchanged recipient JPEG only. Angular interpolation is periodic. Remeasured segmentation moments may move under this edit.
inference: During support preparation process only the authorized eight images of each predicted label and active fold. No current query photograph may enter any of its support or prediction calculations. The image editor reads only frozen conditions and archived generated JPEGs. Scoring opens the true originals only after both panels' blind edit manifests have been sealed.
primary: Remeasure all emitted JPEGs with the same fixed foreground network. Compare matched with prior and exchanged EEG in mean absolute error of the normalized outline. Check the rendered images with independent frozen DINOv2-S/14 final CLS exact photograph retrieval among ten photographs of the same true object and among the full 120 originals. Compute normalized luminance correlation and RGB RMSE at 32x32. The two panels jointly resample their twelve true object classes within panel, using ten photographs per sampled class and holding all four equal-noise arms together; 10000 draws, seed 260556. Also give separate per-panel counts. Report evidence for a deployable change only with positive lower intervals on both shape contrasts and no observed within-ten DINO loss to either control.
